Your Comfort, Our Priority

About Lumi Airbnb

The story of Lumi homes

Lumi Airbnb is built around one idea: a short stay should feel like coming home. We want you to walk in, put your bags down and feel relaxed straight away.

Our apartments are fully furnished with Wi-Fi, comfortable beds, a TV and everything you need to cook, so you can live as you would at home. We host at Whitehouse Apartment in Thome and in Tsavo, Roysambu.

Couples, students, travellers and families all stay with us. Whoever you are, you get the same welcome and the same care. Your comfort is our priority.

Owned and managed by Willis and Martin

We look after every booking ourselves, so you always deal with the people who run the homes.

Terms and conditions

Please read these terms before you book. By booking with Lumi Airbnb you agree to them.

Bookings

A booking request is confirmed only when we reply to confirm your dates and the apartment. Prices are shown in Kenya shillings per night. We will share payment details when we confirm.

Payment and cancellations

Payment terms, deposits and any cancellation or change rules are agreed with the host at the time of booking. Ask us before you pay if you are unsure.

Check-in and check-out

We confirm check-in and check-out times when you book. Please tell us if you expect to arrive late so we can arrange your entry.

Guests and house rules

  • Only the guests named in your booking may stay, unless we agree otherwise.
  • Keep noise low and respect neighbours, especially at night.
  • No illegal activity on the premises.
  • Please treat the apartment, furniture and equipment with care.

Damage and loss

Guests are responsible for damage to the apartment or its contents during their stay, beyond normal wear and tear. Please report any problem as soon as you notice it.

Liability

We take care to keep our homes safe and clean, but guests stay and use the facilities, including the gym where available, at their own risk. We are not responsible for lost or stolen personal belongings.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The version on this page applies to new bookings.

Contact

Questions about these terms? Call or WhatsApp 0782 480 369.

Cookie policy

This policy explains how this website uses cookies and similar browser storage.

What we use

This website stores one small item in your browser to remember your cookie choice, so we do not ask you again on every visit. It does not identify you.

What we do not use

We do not currently use advertising cookies, tracking cookies or analytics on this website. If that changes, we will update this page and ask for your consent first.

Third-party content

The website loads its fonts from Google Fonts. Google may receive your IP address and browser details when it serves them. When you tap WhatsApp or Maps links, you leave this website and those services apply their own policies.

Your choices

You can clear stored data at any time in your browser settings. Doing so will show the cookie notice again.
